params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Sivir}} basic attacks and damaging abilities against enemy {{tip|champions}} briefly grant her a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|move speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Sivir's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} and {{tip|ability}} hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|changedisplay=true|55 to 75 for 5|1;6;11;16;18}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
params.notes: * ''Fleet of Foot'' will trigger even if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}} or misses due to {{tip|blind}} or if the ability is negated by a {{tip|spell shield}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sivir}} hurls her crossblade in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: At max range, it homes back to '''Sivir''' to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' hurls her crossblade in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within its path, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 40|critScaling=true}}.
params.description2: ''Boomerang Blade's'' damage is reduced by {{pp|key=%|changedisplay=true|type=non-champions hit|0 to 60 for 5|0 to 4|formula=Damage{{equals}}100%-(15%*Nº of non-champions hit). ''This is capped at 40% damage at 4 enemies hit.''|label=Damage penalty}}. Upon reaching maximum range, the crossblade returns to her, resetting the damage modifier and dealing the same damage to enemies on its way back.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Minimum Damage|{{ap|60*0.4 to 160*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 24% AP)}}}}
{{st|Total Maximum Champion Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 160*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
params.description3: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
params.cast time: {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.25;0.231;0.198;0.165;0.132;0.1|key1=%|0;15.2;41.6;68;94.4;120|formula=0.25*(1-(0.5 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 60% reduction at 120% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}
params.notes:
* Due to the cast time effectively rounding up to full game ticks, at undisturbed game tick interval times the technical minimum cast time is {{rutngt|0.1875}} reached at {{as|{{fd|99.8}}% '''bonus''' attack speed}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The damage reduction per unit hit resets back to full damage upon changing direction.
* ''Boomerang Blade'' will still return to '''Sivir''' even if she dies before it changes direction.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sivir}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds. During this time, her basic attacks create projectiles that repeatedly bounce to nearby surrounding enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' empowers her crossblade for the next 4 seconds, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and causing her {{tip|basic attacks}} to bounce to additional surrounding enemies, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to them. If the triggering attack {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}, the bounces will do so as well for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Sivir|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage. ''Ricochet'' deals 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} and executes them if they would be left below {{sti|{{as|15 health}}}}.
params.description2: Bounces occur only up to 8 times and can target each enemy up to one additional time per empowered attack. They prioritize the nearest new target, then the nearest target if no new targets are available.
params.description3: ''Ricochet {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sivir's''' basic attack timer if it was {{tt|not already active|See notes}}. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be bounced to.''
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|{{ccd|Sivir|missile_speed}}|Attack missile speed, same as basic attack}}| {{tt|1000|Bounced missile speed}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Ricochet''-enhanced basic attacks can bounce from structures onto secondary targets but not from nearby units onto structures.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Ricochet's '' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}}, {{tip|block|blocking}}, and {{tip|blind|blinding}} effects.
* ''Ricochet'' do not apply to additional targets with {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}.
* '''Sivir's''' attack timer will only reset from casting ''Ricochet'' if the ability's buff was not already active on her. Refreshing the buff will not grant an attack reset.{{bug}}

params.blurb2: '''Sivir''' {{tip|heals}} herself and activates {{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}} if it blocks an ability.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains a {{tip|spell shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, she {{tip|heals}} herself and activates ''{{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}}'' after {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Spell Shield'' will heal and activate {{ai|Fleet of Foot|Sivir}} if any effect is blocked. This includes effects such as [[champion ability|champion abilities]], [[Named item effect|item effects]], {{uis|Dragon}} basic attacks, as well as the abilities of {{ui|Baron Nashor}} and {{ui|Rift Herald}}.
* ''Spell Shield'' will still block abilities that have already been applied to '''Sivir''' if the delayed effects of that ability is [[area of effect]] (e.g. {{ai|Blaze 2|Brand|Blaze's}} explosion, {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}}, and {{ai|Time Bomb|Zilean}}).

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sivir}} gains ''On the Hunt'' for a period, and creates an aura that grants allied champions ''On the Hunt'' for the remaining duration. '''Sivir''' can refresh her duration whenever she scores an enemy {{tip|takedown}} within a short time of damaging them.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|On the Hunt:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. '''Sivir's''' basic attacks {{sti|cdr|reduce}} her current basic ability cooldowns.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sivir''' gains ''On the Hunt'' for a duration and grants it to nearby allied champions for the remaining duration.
params.description3: While active, '''Sivir's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} reduce her basic abilities' {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} by {{fd|0.5}} seconds each.
params.description4: '''Sivir''' can refresh the duration of her ''On the Hunt'' buff whenever she scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them.
